about_the_game:
Whispering Stacks is a cozy roguelite side-scrolling zap-em-up where you play a wizard trying really hard to study at the library while its magical inhabitants do everything in their power to stop you.

  • Zap your way through a randomly generated library full of magical foes on your quest for arcane knowledge

  • Collect stylish outfits you totally didn’t loot from a giant moth

  • Build your own cozy reading nook where you can relax after a long day of fighting mythical creatures

  • Befriend virtual companions and invite them to stay in your reading nook

  • Collect mythical artifacts like the Divination of Tranquillity Tarot deck

  • Run in terror from librarians
